integrity: The infinite result follows from the explicit mathematical proof; finite graph and modular-reachability checks are supporting reproduction tests, not an infinite formal certificate. Scholarly overlap beyond sources inspected remains possible. No independent audit or validation has occurred.
limitations: Only the minimum over all connecting maps is determined, for first factor cycles of order at least three and second factor cycles congruent to one modulo three. The domination number for prescribed connecting maps, enumeration of optimal maps, and other second-factor congruence classes are not claimed.
title: Exact Sierpiński domination for cycles of length one modulo three
